title: PolicyCard deck book (G7 content-decks; §7.14 / Appendix B)
description: Shape of packages/content/decks/*.json — a JSON book of PolicyCards a host reads to feed the boot.rules rider. The wire sibling is apps/proto/src/shared/protocol.ts BootRulesWire ({hash, card} entries); hashes stay host-owned lookup keys (protocol.ts:355-362) and NEVER live in this file. Fields the strict loader would fence (era, availableFrom) are deliberately absent — the schema must not invite them. Only the subset this repo's script/validate.mjs interpreter understands is used declaratively here (type, enum, pattern, required, items, minItems/maxItems). Two honest interpreter limits: boolean additionalProperties:false is DECLARED as law but not machine-enforced by the interpreter, and enum is only checked on strings — so the exact-key fences and the schemaVersion=1 wall are hand-enforced on the validator deck leg. The deeper grammar-meaning walls — comparator×threshold arm pairing, runbookName discipline, estate ref null, positive FOR duration, non-negative upkeep, else band-ref pairing, duplicate card ids, appliesTo resolution, §9.11 technique bans, door-carrier coverage — are hand-enforced clause-for-clause against packages/sim-core/src/policy/grammar.ts validatePolicyCard.

schemaVersion.description: Deck-file version space, its own (i18n-pack precedent). The interpreter cannot police integer enums; the validator leg fails loud on anything but 1.

name.description: Human title for the shelf; no engine meaning.

appliesTo.description: Bundle-id grammar (validate.mjs ID_RE namespace form). Resolves at runtime to a shipped types/*.json id OR a reserved core:* id — the hand-enforced resolution wall; v0 has no bundle claimant for decks, so no reverse orphan law is invented.

cards.description: The book. An empty array is legal (boot.rules {entries:[]} posture); duplicate card ids within one deck FAIL mechanically — both the hand-written validator (validate.mjs deck leg) and the loader parse wall, naming both positions (the door's card-id-collision law, intent-door.ts handlePolicyCardCommit: the book is a set keyed by id); duplicates across co-shipped decks get a mechanical WARN (never a fail) — hosts keying lookup by id must adjudicate.

ref.description: Non-empty for every kind except estate; estate MUST be null (grammar.ts:231-233, hand-enforced both ways).

when.description: Grammar tuple 1..3 — one rule = one story (types.ts:697). Interpreter minItems/maxItems support verified by probe.

items.$comment: predicate — duplicated for unless because the interpreter has no $ref.

amount.description: Fixed bigint as decimal string (WireFixed law).

durationUs.description: Sustained-window debounce, µs decimal string; strictly positive is a hand-enforced wall (grammar.ts:246).

runbookName.description: Non-empty ONLY on run-runbook; null everywhere else (grammar.ts:201-205, hand-enforced).

value.description: Fixed as decimal string where the verb takes one; null otherwise.

ref.description: Non-empty always; when to=band it must be inform|consult|execute (grammar.ts:260-262, hand-enforced).

upkeepMicroUsd.description: MoneyUnit as decimal string; non-negativity (grammar.ts:268) is the hand-enforced ^\d+$ wall.

_provenance.description: Optional card-id -> doc-cite map (nulls require _provenance._todo, house never-invent law).
